reason: Explicit precedence covers home-tool exceptions, policy identity and changed aggregate procedures.
Actual executable write/link controls precede every diagnostic discovery/test/version/suite; artifacts bound separately.
No-op must run normally with all applicable successes, and be rejected specifically for absent denials; crash/missing JSON fails batch.
Bounded NFC literal encoder rejects quotes/backslashes/controls; component containment and deterministic complete aliases/exclusions have acceptance cases.
Known unresolved auth roots block guard qualification with guard_unavailable; unknown unexcluded secrets remain disclosed risk.

SOURCE moves to read-only TRUST; use actual harmless tracked Package.swift write-open without data mutation, no synthetic export contamination. Placeholder STAGE removed before absent-output build; finally cleanup every exit.
Offline fixed version/demo/black-box routes remain conditionally permitted; live auth/UI/performance remain outside batch.
Pilot one attempt/template and one controller-only retry total; later mandatory phase probes only after pilot success. No root budget resets.
Name pre-final-review model-generated payloads and artifact output channel. Disclose readable host config classes; add service/log/core exclusions. Approval covers later phases too.

Paired temp aliases used consistently for TRUST/WORK/SOURCE/STAGE. Same-inode alias tests include available case/Data/tmp spellings; unavailable paths not passing evidence. Universal alias coverage unproven.
Temp exclusion is data-read only; metadata/readlink stays default-allowed outside sensitive roots, WORK realpath/getcwd positive control added.

SOURCE outside writable WORK, diagnostics write filter excludes STAGE without ordering reliance. Global file-link denial plus positive/guarded source/actual executable link controls and audits. Decline0444 as a substitute because it confounds attribution and alters audited modes.

Fixed account-home/optional env-path inputs only, no contents/config scans; known unresolved/overlap fail. Every prepare creates/removes private nonce home/Darwin-temp sentinels; disclose trusted-parent side effects.

Deterministic generation/golden checks cover all fixed/configured exclusions. Checkout harmless tracked-file open and driver-only record canary add direct evidence; secret roots remain declared unprobed policy.
Every role/record root under excluded home/temp prefix, no cross-role exceptions; sibling sentinel and placement checks. Normal CLI candidate-blindness remains cooperative.
Precedence explicitly removes both home-tool exceptions; tool/exclusion collision fails guard_unavailable.
Normative record grammar correction must be recorded/presented before worker freeze/dispatch; wording/controller edits only are routine. No counts relaxed.
Retry only demonstrated unguarded/no-op argv/serialization failure with no guarded result. Any signal abort/failed no-op/guard result disqualifies retry; one total pilot retry, restricted diff.
Disclose new untested temp/private-var-folders data restriction and additional exclusions; no feasibility success inferred from old broader marker profile.
Retain original EPERM/EACCES contract, record actual errno and same-resource identity/mode/bytes/link controls. Do not adopt unsupported universal EPERM-only distinction.
Add TRUST/peer writes, own Darwin-user-temp sentinel and alias checks; /dev/null remains prior exception.
Order unguarded then functioning no-op then guarded startup/matrix; no-op once per recipe with explicit inventory.

Driver durable sanitized records outside checkout/excluded; prepare in-memory names then existing aggregates only. Owned-root finally cleanup, no escalation or publication on unresolved required cleanup; bounded WORK Unix path, no socket relocation.
R2 driver acceptance explicitly binds build recipe without new manifest key.
